newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's 3-mth CD yields end up, 3-yr yields flat.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's 3-mth CD yields end up, 3-yr yields flat.

text.p: Three-month CD yields closed sharply higher on Monday due to a slight rise in cash demand that led to increased new issuances by commercial banks, dealers said.
Yields on three-year corporate bonds fell in early trading but closed the day unchanged because of late profit-taking.
The overnight call rate remained unchanged.
* 3-mth CDs end at 14.30 pct vs Saturday's 14.00
* Overnight call average unchanged at 13.00 pct
Rising yields on commercial papers, which have the same maturity as CDs, make CDs less tempting, dealers said.
"Growing yields on commercial papers quickly affected buying interest in CDs," said Kim Yun of Daewoo Securities.
Despite the growing cash demand, the overnight call rate remained unchanged with the average level at 13.00 percent, they said.
